serpProducts.name: Manfrotto PIXI Mini Tripod Kit with Smartphone Clamp (MKPIXICLAMP-BK)
serpProducts.note: DCW names the exact kit (PIXI with Smartphone Clamp); TechGearLab names the PIXI Mini Tripod Kit; Cameraegg and Shotkit name the PIXI Mini. The plain PIXI (MTPIXI-B) is already featured in best-mini-tripod-for-desk-video-calls, so this post uses the clamp kit SKU.

serpProducts.name: JOBY GorillaPod 1K Kit (JB01503)
serpProducts.note: Wirecutter names the GorillaPod 1K Kit as its pick (search snippet; page not readable). Skies & Scopes, the Tripadvisor thread and the Facebook group snippet recommend a GorillaPod-style bendy tripod without naming a size; TechGearLab and Cameraegg name the larger 3K Kit, which has no standalone Amazon US listing.

serpProducts.name: JOBY GripTight ONE GP Stand (JB01491)
serpProducts.note: Shotkit names it (Best flexible mini). A Tripadvisor poster recommends the iPhone GorillaPod at about 71 g, the GP Stand's listed weight. Digital Trends' iPhone tripod roundup (seen in search results) covers the GripTight One GorillaPod Stand.

droppedProducts.name: JOBY TelePod Mobile
droppedProducts.reason: Recommended by Digital Camera World and the Reddit thread, but discontinued at B&H and no Amazon US listing found.

droppedProducts.name: JOBY GorillaPod 3K Kit
droppedProducts.reason: Named by TechGearLab and Cameraegg, but B&H lists it as no longer available and Amazon US shows only the 3K Video PRO and bundle kits.

droppedProducts.name: KraftGeek JustTap / UBeesize
droppedProducts.reason: Already featured in best-phone-tripod-for-vlogging-with-remote; JustTap is a tall selfie-stick tripod, which Skies & Scopes advises against for long night exposures.
